_comment: A station's line the first time it buys any good from the captain, one per market system; the Fulcrum and Heron's Mark have none. The Godot port reads this file (bug bash BB-27); Python does not. Working text for the writing session.

first_sale_lines.speaker: Purchasing associate, Central Exchange
first_sale_lines.text: New supplier on the register. File the form before your next load.

first_sale_lines.speaker: Cooperative buyer
first_sale_lines.text: The cooperative logs you as a supplier. Unload at the grain shed.

first_sale_lines.speaker: Intake counter
first_sale_lines.text: Guild desk and Union desk both logged it. You're paid either way.

first_sale_lines.speaker: Shift foreman
first_sale_lines.text: Unload at bay two. Day shift takes it from there.

first_sale_lines.speaker: Procurement officer
first_sale_lines.text: Delivery accepted. A supplier record is open under your ship.

first_sale_lines.speaker: Stallholder
first_sale_lines.text: First load from you here. Leave it at the stall.

first_sale_lines.speaker: Wrecker
first_sale_lines.text: Set it down by the breaking yard. You're paid at the gate.

first_sale_lines.speaker: Buyer, Grand Bazaar
first_sale_lines.text: First lot from you. I'll want to know where the next one comes from.

first_sale_lines.speaker: Quartermaster
first_sale_lines.text: Leave it by the lift. I'll log you as a supplier.

first_sale_lines.speaker: Buyer
first_sale_lines.text: New supplier noted. Payment is off the open board.
